description.Name: Social Decision-Making Risky Choice Task Dataset
ReferencesAndLinks: Piva, M., Velnoskey, K., Jia, R., Nair, A., Levy, I., & Chang, S. W. (2019). The dorsomedial prefrontal cortex computes task-invariant relative subjective value for self and other. eLife, 8, e44939.

latestSnapshot.readme: This task requires participants to make choices either for themselves or for other individuals in the study between a larger amount of money with a smaller probability of receiving reward or a smaller amount of money with a higher probability of receiving reward. Participants were matched with those with similar preferences. Agent refers to decision-making for Self (0) or Other (1). Probability is the probability of receiving the reward as a proportion. Money is the potential reward in USD.
